rule.message:
All students must complete the University's  Liberal Education requirements.
Collegiate Requirements:
All CLA BA degrees require 18 upper-division (3xxx-level or higher) credits outside the major designator. These credits must be taken in designators different from the major designator and cannot include courses that are cross-listed with the major designator. The major designator for the German, Scandinavian, Dutch BA is GER.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of any second language, with a grade of C-, or better, or S, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) must complete the First-Year Experience course sequence.
All incoming CLA first-year (freshmen) students earning a BA, BS, or BIS degree must complete CLA 3002 or another approved career or internship course (CLA 3101, CLA 3201, CLA 3301, CLA 3896, or CLA 3996.
All students must complete a capstone in at least one CLA major. The requirements for double majors completing the capstone in a different CLA major will be clearly stated. Students must also complete all major requirements in both majors to allow the additional capstone to be waived. Students completing an additional degree must complete the Capstone in each degree area.
Students are required to complete 4 semester(s) of Dutch, or Finnish, or German, or Norwegian, or Swedish. with a grade of C-, or better, or demonstrate proficiency in the language(s) as defined by the department or college.
Students may combine coursework across the department's designators, or to concentrate on one area by declaring an sub-plan (either German or Scandinavian & Finnish). In order to add a German or Scandinavian & Finnish sub-plan to your transcript, courses in the competencies, and 3 of 5 electives must be in the appropriate designator(s). Students who take courses taught in English will integrate work in the language of emphasis, as directed by the course instructor or the director of undergraduate studies.
At least 17 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
Complete any sub-plan requirements that apply to you: German, Scandinavian & Finnish. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.
